name: toastmasters
description: Manage your Toastmasters club participation on easy-Speak: check and set meeting attendance, claim roles, and see when you are next speaking. Drives the easy-Speak web UI in a browser, since the site has no API. Requires browser automation to be available to the agent — see the skill's Requirements section.

interface.shortDescription: Manage your Toastmasters meeting attendance and roles on easy-Speak.
interface.longDescription:
Ask in plain language whether you are signed up for the next meeting, say whether you are coming, and take a role like Timer or Toastmaster — without hunting through the easy-Speak signup grid.

You stay in control. It opens easy-Speak in a browser, you sign in yourself, and it always says exactly what it is about to change and waits for your yes. Afterwards it re-reads the page and reports what actually happened, rather than assuming it worked.

Works with clubs on easy-speak.org, toastmasterclub.org and tmclub.eu.
defaultPrompt: Am I signed up for my next Toastmasters meeting?
Mark me as coming to Monday's meeting.
Which roles are still open at the next meeting?
Sign me up as Timer for the next meeting.
